final_resume.summary: Computer Science graduate seeking a Software Development Engineer II role, with hands-on experience building full-stack web applications using Java, Spring Boot, and React. Demonstrates strong problem-solving ability and attention to operational excellence through end-to-end project delivery.

projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement
projects.description: Built a Spring Boot REST API and React TypeScript frontend to split shared expenses. Integrated Razorpay test-mode payments with webhooks for created, captured and refunded states. Wrote 40 JUnit tests and containerised the app with Docker, ensuring reliability across payment flows.

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Designed and implemented a Java and Spring Boot service with a MySQL schema for booking study rooms. Piloted for 2 weeks with 120 students, eliminating double bookings through transactional integrity.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: Developed a React and TypeScript dashboard consuming a REST API to track order status. Containerised with Docker Compose for local development and deployment consistency.

profile_improvement_tips: Study and implement algorithms (sorting, searching, graph traversal, dynamic programming) in a portfolio project to demonstrate algorithmic thinking.
Design a distributed system project (e.g., a microservices-based application with message queues, caching, or eventual consistency) to show understanding of scalability and fault tolerance.
Learn and apply design patterns (Singleton, Factory, Observer, Strategy) explicitly in code; document them in project READMEs or code comments.
Contribute to open-source projects or create a peer-review process in your own projects to gain hands-on code review experience and document it.
final_resume.growth_note: You are a strong fresher with solid full-stack fundamentals, but the SDE II role requires 3+ years of professional experience and 2+ years of systems design expertise. Your projects demonstrate coding ability and testing discipline, but lack evidence of distributed systems, algorithms, design patterns, and code review practices that the role emphasises. Focus on gaining these skills through advanced projects and internships before applying to mid-level roles.
